question: Which distinct controlled model should define the requested genuinely topological Chern-band obstruction test?

options.summary: Use the two-band square-lattice Qi–Wu–Zhang model.
options.consequence: Add a separate trivial/nontrivial two-component square-Brillouin-zone benchmark with exact gap boundaries, Chern and Wilson diagnostics, finite-mesh refinement, and explicit rank-one Wannier obstruction. Do not identify it with the scalar continuum cosine parent.

options.summary: Use a rational-flux square-lattice Hofstadter model.
options.consequence: Add a magnetic enlarged-cell multi-band benchmark with explicit flux, magnetic gauge, band Chern numbers, and obstruction controls, accepting the additional magnetic-cell and band-selection complexity.

options.summary: Use the two-band honeycomb Haldane model.
options.consequence: Add a trivial/nontrivial honeycomb benchmark with complex next-neighbor hopping and Chern obstruction, accepting a lattice-geometry, primitive-vector, and two-site-basis change.

options.summary: Reconsider or defer the topological extension.
options.consequence: Retain the scalar zero-Chern control and make no claim about a genuinely topological Wannier obstruction.

options.summary: Implement all three models as separate controlled benchmarks.
options.consequence: Implement Qi--Wu--Zhang, Hofstadter, and Haldane as three separately labeled synthetic benchmarks with distinct state spaces, parameters, convergence studies, Chern and Wilson diagnostics, obstruction evidence, and limitations. Do not combine their errors or identify any of them with the scalar continuum cosine parent. No successor is activated.

recommendation: Option A, because the Qi–Wu–Zhang model introduces the minimum two-component structure required for a nonzero Chern band, retains the square Brillouin-zone organization, has exact gap-closing boundaries, supports inexpensive mesh refinement, and isolates topology from magnetic enlarged-cell and honeycomb-geometry changes.
blocked_scope: Implementation, calculation, interpretation, and manuscript integration of a genuinely topological periodic-2D obstruction benchmark.
safe_scope: The completed scalar and direct composite calculations, deterministic validation, Wannier90 interface preparation, and read-only model analysis without selecting or calculating a topological benchmark.
authorized_scope: Implement Qi--Wu--Zhang, Hofstadter, and Haldane as three separately labeled synthetic benchmarks with distinct state spaces, parameters, convergence studies, Chern and Wilson diagnostics, obstruction evidence, and limitations. Do not combine their errors or identify any of them with the scalar continuum cosine parent. No successor is activated.
